business_problem: ani.tech needed an AI-native data layer that could support autonomous financial-workflow agents after MySQL and rigid SaaS-era schemas became a bottleneck for experimentation and deployment.
solution_summary: ani.tech rebuilt its platform on MongoDB Atlas running on Microsoft Azure so it could feed autonomous AI agents with flexible operational and analytical data. The company moved beyond a Django-and-MySQL SaaS model after realizing relational migrations and slow deployment cycles were a poor fit for agentic AI in wealth management. Atlas now acts as the primary operational data platform across a core application database and a data-warehouse-style environment, managing about 22.6 million documents in 202 collections. Agents store real-time chat histories and workflow state directly in MongoDB, while tool-calling agents query the same platform for financial insights, risk exposure, and long-range time-series data. Because MongoDB sits on top of clients’ existing CRM and operational systems, ani.tech can restructure legacy data into AI-friendly forms without forcing wholesale rip-and-replace modernization. The result is an Azure-based AI-native platform that lets the startup iterate quickly while automating complex advisory tasks.
